summary: OCHA records two Palestinians injured in separate settler vehicle-stoning incidents on Mar. 19 and Mar. 27; event-level work has now resolved the Mar. 19 component but not the second component.
discovery_sources: OCHA Protection of Civilians 14-27 Mar 2023; WAFA; PLO NAD daily/monthly reports; canonical Sheet reconciliation
resolution_notes: State correction: the Mar. 19 Al-Maarajat component is already canonical ILPV-2023-0323, based on WAFA and NAD event-level reporting naming Munir Ahmed Abdullah Mur; do not duplicate it. Residual work is limited to the Deir Istiya component naming Muhammad Sami Muhammad Abu Rabi'. NAD's daily report places that event on Mar. 27 while its monthly report dates it Mar. 26, and no independent exact-event corroboration/media was recovered. Preserve the aggregate candidate as Unresolved until that residual component is independently resolved or explicitly blocked.
media_status: ILPV-2023-0323 has no exact incident media; no exact media recovered for the residual Deir Istiya component and no substitute imagery used.
